decisions.reason: Having survived the first post-launch review and being closely tied to the firm's core data and tariff capabilities, this product likely meets a satisfactory minimum and is worth retaining.
This calculator fits the firm's main customer problems and platform direction, so with no clear sign of failure management would continue it rather than redeploy resources.

Although less prominently marketed and somewhat exposed to portfolio rationalisation across its models, it still supports the central tariff-calculation platform and would likely be kept while results remain acceptable.

After two years, a lightly presented and overlapping comparison line would be more likely to fall below aspiration levels, making resource reallocation to stronger core offerings and new development the better choice.
